summary: built and measured by ce-cad: one valid closed solid per instance, 4.6 mm3 (positive, reach R9.50) and 5.8 mm3 (negative, reach R6.00), 0.15 mm stock x 3.60 mm wide, a 30 deg arc cantilever at R11.60 giving L = 6.074 mm, with a Ø0.90 dimple 0.100 mm proud. The SPRING RATE IS CALCULATED, NOT MEASURED: k = 3EI/L^3 = 1.4912 N/mm, 0.596 N per finger at the 0.400 mm working deflection (268.4 MPa, 45% of C5191 yield) and 0.969 N pressed (436.1 MPa, 74%). w/L = 0.59 so the strip is partly a plate and the true rate is up to 12% higher. A force gauge on a stamped sample settles it.
by: claude (halo lane M, mechanical), ce-cad bin/cad design.py, 2026-09-04
